newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Firmer Brussels bourse nears resistance.
newsitem.headline: Firmer Brussels bourse nears resistance.

text.p: The Brussels bourse advanced in morning trade on Wednesday after an overnight surge in New York, but traders said players were cautious ahead of market holidays and as the Bel-20 index .BFX neared key resistance.
"We are stronger, but it is mainly professional activity," one trader said.

"Institutionals are wary of what may be behind the rise and with the market closed on Thursday, many people are likely to be away on Friday and...Britain and the United States (are) closed on Monday," he added.
